cipher.name: WordPositionSwapCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, highly structured word-level transposition cipher designed to maximize semantic coherence and reasoning accuracy. It swaps adjacent pairs of words in the text (the 1st word swaps with the 2nd, the 3rd with the 4th, and so on). If a sentence has an odd number of words, the last word remains in its position. Punctuation marks are treated as part of the word they are attached to, preserving natural sentence boundaries while completely disrupting standard token sequences.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
1. Split the input text into words by spaces.
2. Group the words into adjacent pairs: (word1, word2), (word3, word4), etc.
3. Swap the positions of the words in each pair: word2 becomes word1, and word1 becomes word2.
4. If there is an odd word at the end without a partner, leave it in its original position.
5. Join the swapped words back together with single spaces.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
1. Split the encrypted text into words by spaces.
2. Group the words into adjacent pairs: (word1, word2), (word3, word4), etc.
3. Swap the positions of the words in each pair back to their original order.
4. If there is an odd word at the end, leave it in its position.
5. Join the words back together with single spaces to reconstruct the original text.
